scope: Every occurrence in the pinned 34-root / 473 org-site mutation inventory. Descriptions/types remain in that inventory at source_field_index. No live calibration.
limitations: Cosmetic is network non-interference in direct updates, not a promise about external automation, push timing, full-stack completeness or all cloud behavior. Never use this ledger to authorize an unsupported object or action.

rationales.cosmetic: Registered scalar administrative/display metadata. Network-inert within the direct update contract; schema validation, companion edits and derived gates still run.
rationales.identity: Immutable identity/audit/status in this resource context; excluded from raw network deltas. Not a permission to mutate identities or reassign resources.
rationales.checked: Admitted to existing checks, not inherently safe. Coverage, confidence, effective dependencies, values and runtime evidence determine the verdict.
rationales.atomic: The diff admits the containing list atomically. Element/union grammar is not independently certified by that admission; needs contextual semantic validation.
rationales.boundary: Open, recursive, unconstrained or unresolved shape. New children cannot inherit a cosmetic exception or prove behavioral completeness.
rationales.selector: Identity, name, reference, assignment or inheritance can select or generate configuration. A display-like spelling is not a non-interference proof.
rationales.operational: Alarms, telemetry, schedules, power, upgrades, push policy or device operations have experience/operational effects outside a cosmetic contract.
rationales.behavior: Forwarding, routing, security, admission, services, RF or external state requires a validated mechanism/dependency model. Unmodeled leaves remain default-denied.
rationales.unsupported_context: No simulation contract for this object/platform/action. A harmless-looking leaf does not license the endpoint or its side effects.
